podcast.body: A cover of a 1973 hit by the glam rock band Slade, this track was the first single from the *Metal Health* album and quickly climbed to number five on the Billboard Top 40 in November 1983. Its music video, which cost about $40,000 to produce, played a crucial role in breaking the band into the mainstream, receiving airplay every half hour on MTV. "Cum On Feel the Noize a cover of the 1973 hit from the glam rock band slayed. Was the first single it made its number five on the Billboard top 40 in November 1983."
